Taking a basis of 100 atoms: 5 atoms of Cu and 95 atoms of Pt.

- Mass of Cu = $5 \times 63.55 = 317.75$ g
- Mass of Pt = $95 \times 195.08 = 18532.6$ g
- Total mass = $18850.35$ g

$$w_{\mathrm{Cu}} = \frac{317.75}{18850.35}\times 100 \approx 1.69\,\mathrm{wt\%}$$

$$w_{\mathrm{Pt}} = \frac{18532.6}{18850.35}\times 100 \approx 98.31\,\mathrm{wt\%}$$

$$\boxed{(1.69,\ 98.31)}$$
